content: वृषली .²1 An unmarried girl twelve years old; particularly, a girl remaining unmarried at her fatherʼs house in whom menstruation has commenced; पितुर्गेहे च या नारी रजः पश्यत्यसंस्कृता . भ्रूणहत्या पितुस्तस्याः सा कन्या वृषली स्मृता ... .²2 A woman during menstruation. .²3 A barren woman. .²4 The mother of a still-born child. .²5 A Śūdra female, or the wife of a Śūdra.
